structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: The issue forbids a parallel financial engine and authorizes only canonical read-only and Inbox services.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: Send WhatsApp text to an independent transaction writer or let message fields override canonical tenant-scoped balances.
Require a live Meta provider or AI output for deterministic financial results and leak provider-specific state into the finance domain.
Allow a second WhatsApp replay to insert a second financial suggestion into the Inbox despite identical provider identity.
Retry interrupted extraction from GET or a timer without signed webhook raw body, persisting sensitive fallback text to get unstuck.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: Persistent event journal supports replay, result state and readback with version and status.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: Financial values are sourced from canonical FinancialAssistantService and Inbox, not from WhatsApp sender or copy text.

requested currency in untrusted answer copy
